opening.argument: The presentation demonstrates a paid package flow in which participation begins with a package costing "package which costs 530 euros." The package is then represented as providing 5,000 tokens, stating, "you have received the 5,000 tokens," before directing those tokens into mining: "send those tokens for mining." Weekly and network bonuses are presented as benefits of this participation rather than as incidental account functions. The recruitment incentive is also explicit: the presenter says there is a "direct sales bonus a network bonus when a new member purchase a bloody package." Taken together, the payment, token conversion, mining activation, and bonuses tied to a new member’s purchase establish a paid mining or node-return structure and actively encourage further package purchases.

citations.quote: direct sales bonus a network bonus when a new member purchase a bloody package
